## Milestone / slice

Milestone ID, slice ID and related acceptance/requirement IDs:

## Changes

Describe behavior and any schema/adapter/protocol decisions. Link sources for new printer commands/dependencies.

## Validation actually performed

Environment, exact commands, results and evidence. Distinguish automated, macOS integration and physical testing.

## Not run / blocked

List missing hardware, GUI, minimum-OS, signing or other evidence and the practical limitation.

## Safety / privacy / compatibility

Describe bounds, privileges, command effects, retry/copy behavior and private-data handling affected by this change.

- [ ] Progress and handoff are updated.
- [ ] New targets/tests are included in CI.
- [ ] No proprietary driver artifacts, private labels, fonts or secrets are included.
- [ ] No unsupported hardware/release claims were added.
